data.summary:
Experienced Power Platform Consultant specializing in the design and delivery of enterprise-grade business applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven). Strong expertise in building scalable, secure, and user-centric applications leveraging Dataverse, SharePoint, and SQL Server as backend data sources, with advanced workflow automation using Power Automate.
Proven experience modernizing classic SharePoint forms and workflows, migrating them into responsive Canvas Apps and custom Model-Driven applications, and ensuring seamless functionality across desktop and mobile platforms. I am skilled in customizing classic and modern SharePoint pages and forms, implementing governance and security strategies, and optimizing performance for high-volume enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI-assisted solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Custom Copilots, enabling conversational workflows, contextual data access, and productivity enhancements within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform applications. Experienced in integrating Copilot with Dataverse, SharePoint, and Power Automate while applying security, compliance, and role-based access controls.
Strong background in building reusable component libraries, custom controls, and implementing role-based security models for enterprise applications. Adept at collaborating with stakeholders to align solutions with business processes and operational requirements.
Additional expertise includes Azure development and Microsoft Fabric, supporting integration with cloud services, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and scalable storage solutions. This hybrid skill set enables delivery of process-centric, data-driven, and AI-enabled solutions that support advanced reporting and secure enterprise connectivity.
Recognized for transforming manual and legacy processes into automated, intelligent, and user-friendly solutions. Combines strong technical expertise with client-focused delivery to improve efficiency, drive user adoption, and ensure long-term scalability across Microsoft 365 ecosystems.

Experience
Senior Consultant
Infosys Ltd (Hyderabad – India) Nov 2025 – Present (2 Months 15 days)

Enterprise Application Development Engineer Intel Corporation (Heredia – Costa Rica) Aug 2021 – Aug 2025 (4 years 1 month)

Built AI-enabled solutions and custom copilots to support conversational workflows,
improve user productivity, and deliver contextual business insights.

Implemented secure integrations with third-party systems, databases, and REST APIs using proper credential management, secrets storage, and security best practices.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams (product managers, designers, business analysts,
and developers) to gather requirements, design scalable and secure solutions, and deliver projects following enterprise ALM standards.
Developed clean, efficient, and maintainable Power Platform solutions, adhering to coding
standards and best practices.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform and Power Automate using Azure DevOps, including solution management, environment strategy, and automated deployments.
Maintained and enhanced existing web and Power Platform applications by identifying
performance, usability, and security improvements.
Created and executed test artifacts and validation plans to ensure reliability and accuracy
of Power Automate flows and Copilot responses.
Provided technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform, Copilot, and web
applications, ensuring stable, secure, and optimized production environments.
Supported end users by resolving incidents, analyzing root causes, and improving system
reliability and performance.
Technical Consultant
Infosys (San Jose - Costa Rica) Jan 2020 - Aug 2021 (1 year 8 months)
Developed and customized SharePoint applications using SharePoint Online, SharePoint
Server, SharePoint Designer, and SharePoint Framework (SPFx).
Designed and implemented SharePoint workflows to automate business processes,
improve operational efficiency, and reduce manual effort.

Integrated Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI) with SharePoint to enhance automation, data visualization, and user experience.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders and technical teams, to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver SharePoint and Power Platform projects.
Conducted end-user training and knowledge-transfer sessions to support adoption and
maximize the value of SharePoint and Power Platform solutions.
• Provided technical support and troubleshooting for SharePoint and Power Platform
applications, including issue resolution, system maintenance, and performance improvements.
Senior System Engineer Infosys (Bangalore – India) Mar 2019 - Jan 2020 (11 months)
Developed and customized SharePoint applications using SharePoint Online, SharePoint
Server, SharePoint Designer, and SharePoint Framework (SPFx).
Designed and implemented SharePoint workflows to automate business processes and
improve operational efficiency.

Integrated Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI, with SharePoint to enhance automation, reporting, and user experience.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements, design
technical solutions, and deliver SharePoint and Power Platform projects.
Conducted end-user training and knowledge-transfer sessions to support adoption and
maximize the value of SharePoint and Power Platform solutions.
Provided technical support and troubleshooting, performed system maintenance, and
resolved application and platform issues.
Associate Professional: Application Development DXC Technology (Noida / Hyderabad – India) Oct 2016 - Mar 2019 (2 years 6 months)
Assisted senior SharePoint developers in the design, development, and deployment of SharePoint solutions across SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013, and SharePoint Online environments.
Developed custom SharePoint solutions using the SharePoint Object Model, SharePoint Designer, and custom workflows, improving business processes and overall productivity.
Created and customized SharePoint sites, lists, document libraries, content types, and workflows based on business requirements.
Supported SharePoint 2010 and 2013 on-premises environments, including site configuration, permissions management, and feature customization.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze business needs, and translate them into technical specifications.
Assisted in the migration of SharePoint content from on premises (SharePoint 2010/2013) to SharePoint Online, ensuring data integrity and minimal downtime.
